data.title: 波岛出海 · 数位屏前的神速线稿觉醒
data.description: 工作室乱中有序的书桌前，散落着原稿纸与色卡。出海握着电磁压感笔在发光的超大数位屏上运笔如飞，天才画师的双眸倒映着绚丽屏幕荧光，专注得令人屏息。
data.location: cozy artist studio workspace surrounded by reference books, markers, and glowing drawing monitor
data.action: seated at desk intensely sketching on large pen display tablet, stylist flying across screen, radiant focused amber gaze
data.lighting: 数位绘图屏幕冰蓝强光与案头暖黄台灯
data.promptProse: Izumi sketches with blazing speed on a luminous pen display tablet in her cozy studio, her amber eyes reflecting pure creative brilliance.
data.animaCaption: Vivid screen light washes across her face and bouncing twintails as the stylus dances across the glass.
